artworks.title: Mucius Scaevola Putting his Hand in a Fire
artworks.artist: Anton Maria Zanetti I after Parmigianino
artworks.medium: chiaroscuro woodcut printed from 3 blocks in green, pink, and red on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Rosenwald Collection
artworks.description: This is a drawing of figures surrounding an altar. The central figure wears a helmet and cape, standing to the right with one arm extended towards the burning altar. Another figure stands on the left side assisting with the ceremony or offering. Additional figures, some with bearded faces, are behind them, seemingly observing the ritual. The altar is ornately decorated and emitting visible flames. The image is rendered in a monochrome style, primarily consisting of red and beige tones.

artworks.title: Nave Nave Fenua
artworks.medium: brush, gouache, and india ink with pen and india ink on dark tan wove paper
artworks.creditLine: Rosenwald Collection
artworks.description: The image shows a figure standing with their body angled and arms close to the torso. The figure has medium-length hair with a flower behind one ear. The facial features are not prominently detailed. The person appears unclothed. The background is abstract and colorful, with a stylized landscape and various imaginative elements including a red-tailed lizard and a snake.

artworks.title: Nave Nave Fenua (Delightful Land)
artworks.creditLine: Rosenwald Collection

artworks.title: Te Faruru (They are Making Love Here)
artworks.creditLine: Rosenwald Collection
artworks.description: The image contains fluid, swirling lines that form an abstract depiction. Near the center, a contour resembling a figure is outlined, with flowing lines suggesting long hair cascading from the head. Above the figure, an enigmatic symbol with a circular shape and a vertical stem is located. The text "TE FARURU" is inscribed in the upper right corner.

artworks.title: Te Po (The Long Night)
artworks.medium: woodcut in bistre on cream paper
artworks.creditLine: Rosenwald Collection
artworks.description: The image displays fluid and curvilinear shapes with interweaving lines creating depth and movement. A large round shape resembling a sun or moon is at the top left with radiating lines. Below this form are abstract figures lying down and sitting, with simplified and elongated limbs and heads. Towards the lower right is a smaller flame-like shape. The scene suggests a night setting with shadows and dreamy figures at repose. The letters "TE PO" are inscribed into the figure.

artworks.title: The Universe is Created (L'Univers est créé)
artworks.medium: woodcut in tan, red-brown, red and black [trial proof]
artworks.creditLine: Rosenwald Collection
artworks.description: The image displays swirling lines and amorphous shapes that converge in an abstract composition. White shapes resembling waves or clouds cascade across a dark background. Among the layers, there is a humanoid figure on the left, kneeling. The right side features intricate lines and shapes resembling a face and elongated limbs, adding depth and complexity to the abstract work.

artworks.title: Revolt (Aufruhr)
artworks.creditLine: Rosenwald Collection
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a group of people raising their tools and flags. The scene is dynamic with individuals holding scythes and other implements. Above the crowd, a floating figure appears with a determined expression. In the background is an architectural structure resembling a castle. The composition is rendered in dark tones with strong contrasts.

artworks.title: Venus at Vulcan's Forge
artworks.creditLine: Gift of David Keppel
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a group of figures working in a forge. The scene shows several muscular figures, possibly blacksmiths or workers, hammering on an anvil. The setting includes a stone archway and hanging pelts or fabrics in the background, contributing to the rustic atmosphere. To the right, a figure with draped fabric gestures towards the workers, while a winged child grasps a small container; an armor piece rests on the wall behind them. The composition showcases detailed line work and shading, emphasizing the robust musculature and dynamic postures of the figures.

artworks.title: Head of a Young Girl (Tete de jeune fille)
artworks.creditLine: Gift of George Matthew Adams in memory of his mother, Lydia Havens Adams
artworks.description: The image shows a sketch of a person's head and neck, with a three-quarter view of their face. The person has high cheekbones, large eyes, slightly parted lips, and sleek, close-to-the-head hair. The sketch focuses on the facial features and lacks clothing or objects. The background is plain, and there is a signature in the lower right corner that reads "A. Legros."

artworks.title: Spanish Singers (Les chantres espagnols)
artworks.creditLine: Gift of George Matthew Adams in memory of his mother, Lydia Havens Adams
artworks.description: This is a drawing of several figures gathered around a table with a large book in a dimly lit scene. The figures appear to be engaged in a serious discussion or study, each sitting or standing in a cramped space. The atmosphere is intensely dramatic, shrouded in deep shadow, illuminated only by a single candle placed by the book. The room's darkness is accentuated by the heavy cross-hatching present in the drawing. The figures are portrayed in a style reminiscent of Rembrandt, known for his mastery of chiaroscuro and intimate compositions. The tension and focus of the moment are conveyed through the expressions and postures of the figures.

artworks.title: Saint Peter and Saint Paul in the Door of M. Richard (St. Pierre et St. Paul a la porte de M. Richard
artworks.creditLine: Gift of George Matthew Adams in memory of his mother, Lydia Havens Adams
artworks.description: The image shows two full-body figures standing closely together. Both individuals are leaning slightly, facing each other in a side profile view, positioned near the edge of a stone entryway. The man on the left has defined facial features with a beard and short hair, while the person on the right has a broader face and short hair. Both are wearing long, heavy robes. The individual on the left holds a dark-colored object that appears to be a bag with a string, while the other holds a similarly shaped object in their arms. The figures stand on a stepped stone platform with their feet visible, wearing simple footwear. The background features a finely etched wall made of large stone blocks, with diagonal lines shading the area above them.

artworks.title: G.F. Watts, R.A.
artworks.creditLine: Gift of George Matthew Adams in memory of his mother, Lydia Havens Adams
artworks.description: The image shows a bust drawing of a man with a full beard and mustache. He is turned slightly to the right in a three-quarters view, displaying both sides of his face. The man has a high forehead, deep-set eyes, and a contemplative expression. He wears a cap and a simple robe. The background is plain, and there is a signature in the bottom right corner.

artworks.title: Milkmaid of Boulogne, 3rd plate (Laitiere a Boulogne)
artworks.creditLine: Gift of George Matthew Adams in memory of his mother, Lydia Havens Adams
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a donkey carrying milk churns through a rural landscape. The donkey is depicted moving from left to right with milk churns on its back. In the background, there are trees rendered with dense lines, adding depth to the setting. The donkey and a figure holding a stick are detailed with fine linework. The surroundings are illustrated with hatching techniques to show a forested area, enhancing the rustic and agricultural atmosphere.

artworks.title: Farm on a Hillside in Sunlight (La ferme du coteau; Effet de soleil sur le coteau)
artworks.creditLine: Gift of George Matthew Adams in memory of his mother, Lydia Havens Adams
artworks.description: The image shows a landscape with rolling hills or ridges viewed from a slightly elevated angle. The horizon is positioned towards the upper section with faint structures or formations in the sky. The artwork uses fine, detailed brushstrokes resembling etchings or cross-hatching for texture and depth. The color palette is monochromatic with black and white shades emphasizing contrast. Various lines and marks suggest dense foliage in the foreground, while the background indicates a wider expanse. The scene conveys a serene beauty through meticulous line work and tonal gradations.

artworks.title: Marsh (Les marais)
artworks.creditLine: Gift of George Matthew Adams in memory of his mother, Lydia Havens Adams
artworks.description: The image shows a landscape with a serene expanse of land and water from an elevated point of view. The horizon is situated in the upper third of the composition, with sparse vegetation along its length. Close to us, there are clusters of bushes and shrubs, and a calm body of water reflects their forms. The style features delicate, soft etchings and gentle lines that suggest a light breeze rustling through the foliage. The color palette is minimal, with light and dark shades of sepia or gray, creating a tranquil, monochromatic effect.

artworks.title: Paralytic (Le paralytique)
artworks.creditLine: Gift of George Matthew Adams in memory of his mother, Lydia Havens Adams
artworks.description: The image shows a man seated, captured from the knees upwards. He appears older, with aged features, a prominent brow, and a deeply lined face. His hands are resting on his lap, fingers interlocked. The man's hair is short and receding. He wears a dark, heavy coat, and the background is filled with simple, hatched lines. The overall atmosphere is detailed and textured, created using cross-hatch etching techniques.

artworks.title: Archeologist (L'archeologue)
artworks.creditLine: Gift of George Matthew Adams in memory of his mother, Lydia Havens Adams
artworks.description: The image shows an elderly man seated at a table with documents in front of him. He has a long face with a full beard, sparse slicked-back hair, and a serious expression. He wears a robe or cloak. An open book and a stacked book lie on the table. A lit candle illuminates the scene, casting light and shadows. Books are on a shelf in the background. The setting suggests a dimly lit study, emphasizing the man's concentration and solitude.

artworks.title: Birch Trees: Water's Edge Seen in Morning Light (Les bouleaux: Bord de l'eau, effet du matin
artworks.creditLine: Gift of George Matthew Adams in memory of his mother, Lydia Havens Adams
artworks.description: The image shows a landscape viewed from a ground level perspective, looking across a water body or river towards a row of trees lining the opposite bank. The horizon is subtly indicated by the line of trees, as the landscape appears to fade into an indistinct background, suggesting distant foliage. The artwork utilizes etching techniques, with fine and loose brushstrokes creating an impressionistic style. This effect is achieved through meticulous, wispy lines that suggest the leaves and branches, adding a sense of movement within the stillness. The color palette is monochromatic, with varying shades of grey produced through different densities of lines, which give depth to the landscape. Close to us, the lines are denser and darker, enhancing the texture of the ground and the reflective surface of the water, while in the distance, the lines become sparser and lighter, implying a gradual retreat into the soft depth of the background.

artworks.title: Return to the Cottage (Le retour a la chaumiere)
artworks.creditLine: Gift of George Matthew Adams in memory of his mother, Lydia Havens Adams
artworks.description: The image shows a figure carrying a bundle of wood in a wooded area. The scene features intricate, crosshatched lines creating a textured effect. The color palette is monochromatic, using shades of black and gray. Light source in the distance illuminates the scene, casting highlights on the figure and creating contrast against the lines.

artworks.title: Roman Ruin (Ruine romaine)
artworks.creditLine: Gift of George Matthew Adams in memory of his mother, Lydia Havens Adams
artworks.description: The image depicts a landscape viewed from a slightly elevated perspective. The horizon is low in the image, showing a wide expanse of sky. On the horizon, there are outlines of distant trees and a building. The style shows delicate, detailed linework resembling an etching, with fine lines and hatching creating texture and depth. The color palette is primarily monochrome, emphasizing the etching technique. Closest to us is a large, arched stone formation, likely an ancient structure, with overgrown vegetation indicated by dense cross-hatching. Beyond this, the landscape lightens in tone as it recedes towards the horizon.

artworks.title: Meadow in Sunshine (Le pre ensoleille)
artworks.creditLine: Gift of George Matthew Adams in memory of his mother, Lydia Havens Adams
artworks.description: The image features a landscape with a high horizon, trees drawn with etching strokes to create texture, a monochrome color palette, a figure lying on the ground, a cluster of tall trees, and rolling hills in the background.

artworks.title: Memories of Fountainebleau in the Rain (Souvenir de Fountainebleau (Effet de pluie))
artworks.creditLine: Gift of George Matthew Adams in memory of his mother, Lydia Havens Adams
artworks.description: The image shows various organic shapes and textures. The viewpoint is slightly above, looking down at the scene. The horizon is not clearly visible. The image focuses on patterns and shadows created by light and form. The technique used is detailed etching with intersecting lines and shading for depth and texture. The color palette is monochromatic with shades of grey and black. There are curving forms suggesting a natural landscape in the foreground. Lines become lighter and more diffuse in the distance, enhancing depth and space.

artworks.title: Sunrise, Woods of Clamard (Lever du soleil, bois de Clamard)
artworks.creditLine: Gift of George Matthew Adams in memory of his mother, Lydia Havens Adams
artworks.description: The image shows a wooded area with tall, slender trees depicted in a sketch-like manner using fine, cross-hatched lines. The horizon is not prominently marked, as the trees extend into the distance, filling much of the frame. The lines are delicate and expressive, providing texture and capturing the details of the branches and foliage. The color palette is monochromatic, using shades of brown and sepia tones. The light behind the trees creates a diffused glow, brightening the middle section and adding contrast against the darker areas delineated by the cross-hatching.

artworks.title: Ruins of a Monastery (Les ruines du monastere)
artworks.creditLine: Gift of George Matthew Adams in memory of his mother, Lydia Havens Adams
artworks.description: The image shows a scene with an elevated view looking towards a tall, weathered stone structure with an archway and trees nearby. The horizon is obscured by dense foliage and the structure. A cluster of birds is flying above. The brushstrokes are intricate and delicate, with fine lines and cross-hatching techniques used for texture. The color palette is monochromatic with varying shades of black and white. Barren tree silhouettes are etched against the sky.
